THINBORNE – iPhone 17/18 Pro Case Review

ByJim O Brien/CEO

November 13, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:04
Instaread

The THINBORNE  iPhone 18 Pro  Super Thin Aramid Fiber Case with MagSafe in Navy Blue has landed on our review desk and like many cases now super thin with a nice finish to them.

The THINBORNE iPhone 17/18 Pro case is no different here and comes with a screen protector in the very nice presentation box which you do not see that often these days as it is misty plastic bags or cardboard boxes however presentation is key and things people remember these days but not a huge caveat as most will discard the waste but not this box it comes in.

There is no loss to features as expected with cutouts to access your keys and ports and the speakers with a nice hump around the camera plateau and the case has a nice textured finish offering better grip and feels good in the hand.

You have MagSafe built in and works fine on all my wireless chargers in the house here and office and there is a small lip on the front of the case if you have no screen protector on but put the one you get with it on either way.

The materials used are really nice here and Aramid fiber is now a thing with many case manufacturers today and they look great and the cases that are made like this are minimalist to me but look great offering protection over bulkier cases making the phone more cumbersome to hold but the choice is yours, check the video review below for a close up hands-on look at the THINBORNE iPhone 17/18 prosper thin case made with Aramid Fiber and built in MagSafe.,
